{{Quote|The Sith have possessed the Syn Holocron since the time of Bane&mdash;the one in the Temple Archive was a spying device concealed with a shrouding spell.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Syn Holocron''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] that was constructed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sorzus Syn]] near to the end of her life. The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was reacquired by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the time of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], and the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] possessed the device during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] recovered an object that they believed to be the Syn Holocron, but it was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spying]] device that was disguised by a [[shrouding spell]].
